[[Lars the Obeisant]] is a [[White Mantle]] [[boss]] that is part of the expedition seeking to gain access to the [[Henge of Denravi]] ahead of the [[Shining Blade]].

== Missions ==
* [[Maguuma Jungle]]
** {{NPC location|Aurora Glade}}

== Skills ==
He has 15 in [[Domination Magic]] in [[Normal Mode]].
* {{skill icon|Ether Feast}}
* {{skill icon|Guilt}}
* {{skill icon|Shame}}
* {{skill icon|Shatter Enchantment}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Sycophant's Robes]]
* [[White Mantle Badge]]

== Notes ==
* Lars may randomly spawn in one of the points marked on the map. He shares them with [[Holt the Iron Boot Heel]], [[Cuthbert the Chaste]], [[Garr the Merciful]], [[Kenric the Believer]], and [[Manton the Indulgent]]. As such, there is a chance that Lars will not spawn at all.
* Guilt is a skill that may be beneficial to [[Signet of Capture|capture]] from Lars in this mission, since it will only become available as a quest reward of [[the Misplaced Sword]] later in [[Heroes' Audience]] within the [[Crystal Desert]].
